The major product (P) in the following reaction sequence is

The major products Q and R from the following reactions, respectively are
benzoic acid (C₆H₅CO₂H) --i) Br₂, FeBr₃--> (P) --ii) B₂H₆--> Q ; (P) --iii) MeOH, HCl(gas)--> R
options_en: Q = (3-bromophenyl)methanol (CH₂OH with Br meta on the ring) ; R = methyl 3-bromobenzoate (CO₂CH₃ with Br meta on the ring)
Q = (3-bromophenyl)methanol (CH₂OH with Br meta on the ring) ; R = methyl 3-bromobenzoate (CO₂CH₃ with Br meta on the ring)
Q = 3-bromotoluene (CH₃ with Br meta on the ring) ; R = methyl 3-bromobenzoate (CO₂CH₃ with Br meta on the ring)
Q = (3-bromophenyl)methanol (CH₂OH with Br meta on the ring) ; R = methyl 3-methoxybenzoate (CO₂CH₃ with OCH₃ meta on the ring, in place of Br)
questions.note: has diagram — Q/R in each option are skeletal structures. Options 1 and 2 render as IDENTICAL structures (Q = 3-bromobenzyl alcohol, R = methyl 3-bromobenzoate) in the source crop, yet only option 2 carries the green tick; recorded as printed (marked_correct=2). This mirrors the exact-duplicate anomaly also seen at q122 options 3/4.
